outcome: Give hospital coo / chief medical information officer a governed method to improve report turnaround by urgency using imaging orders, urgency flags and service capacity, with final decisions…
overview: Radiology Worklist Prioritisation Support addresses staff search multiple approved sources manually and struggle to preserve permissions and version context in healthcare providers operations. The first proof of value uses imaging orders, urgency flags and service capacity. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is report turnaround by urgency, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: imaging orders, urgency flags and service capacity; define report turnaround by urgency and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Hospital COO / Chief Medical Information Officer.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including golden question set with prompt-injection and authorization tests.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
